Evaluate geometric and conformational feasibility of orbital overlap.
Assign appropriate hybridisation and delocalisation models with model boundaries.

demand_dimensions.model_choice: Choose between localized sp3, planar sp2 with unhybridised p, or orthogonal pi models.
demand_dimensions.representation_translation: Translate verbal formulas and conformations into 3D orbital alignments and nodal planes.
demand_dimensions.reasoning_steps: Local count, adjacency check, overlap symmetry evaluation, energy and model boundary check.
demand_dimensions.novelty: Amide delocalisation, 90-degree torsional decoupling, methyl radical SOMO, and allene orthogonal pi bonds.

safe_variations: Change substituents while preserving the same orbital alignment and conjugation conditions.
transfer_boundaries: Do not equate spatial proximity with through-bond conjugation.
Do not treat hybridisation as a physical cause of bond angles or reactivity.
common_wrong_routes: Apply four domains therefore sp3 automatically without checking adjacent pi systems.
Assume twisting breaks formal electron counts or chemical connectivity.
